collection_gaps.reason: The EKS MCP Server caps list responses at 100 items, offers no pagination on its Kubernetes list tools, and reports no truncation indicator, so a full-length response cannot be distinguished from a complete one. CustomResourceDefinition is cluster-scoped, so it cannot be sharded by namespace the way workloads can. Ownership evidence for this kind is unaffected: it is read separately with a app.kubernetes.io/name existence selector, which only labelled resources match and is therefore complete.
resolution_steps: Cross-check the true count: kubectl get customresourcedefinition --no-headers | wc -l
API groups are also derived from served API versions and from APIService names, so a group missing here may still be present.
Do not treat absence of a CustomResourceDefinition from this snapshot as evidence it does not exist.
collection_gaps.summary: CustomResourceDefinition enumeration returned exactly 100 items and may be incomplete.
